text.aria-label: Title text 'Figure 4: Where ERA5's downward solar radiation differs from CAMS'

g.text: Figure 4: Where ERA5's downward solar radiation differs from CAMS

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Six NGED solar farms, daylight hours, September 2019 to June 2026. ERA5: ECMWF's reanalysis of past weather. CAMS: satellite irradiance service. Top: the gap on the clearest, most variable, and dullest days at one farm, chosen by the CAMS clear-sky index. Positive means ERA5 is brighter. Clear-sky index: measured irradiance divided by the irradiance expected under a cloudless sky. Bottom: hours sorted by the variable named above each panel and split into ten groups of equal numbers of hours. Each dot is one group's mean gap.'
text.tspan: Six NGED solar farms, daylight hours, September 2019 to June 2026. ERA5: ECMWF's reanalysis of past weather. CAMS:
Top: the gap on the clearest, most variable, and dullest days at one farm, chosen by
the CAMS clear-sky index. Positive means ERA5 is brighter.
Clear-sky index: measured irradiance divided by the irradiance expected under a cloudless sky.
Bottom: hours sorted by the variable named above each panel and split into ten groups of equal numbers of hours.
Each dot is one group's mean gap.
